purpose: Preregistered temporal anchor intervals for MCT/GARAS action-origin experiments. Values are hypotheses, not evidence of intrinsic significance.

unit_policy.rule: Every observation MUST declare exactly one unit. The same numeric anchor with different units is treated as a different experimental condition.

measurement_policy.origin_event: Explicitly define the event from which elapsed time is measured, e.g. prompt submitted, response completed, suggestion displayed, action committed, trace emitted.
measurement_policy.window: Use preregistered tolerance windows rather than post-hoc rounding.
measurement_policy.clock: Record monotonic elapsed time where available; also record UTC wall-clock timestamp for auditability.
measurement_policy.no_posthoc_hits: Do not count a timestamp as a hit merely because it can be rounded or transformed into an anchor.

controls.random_intervals: For every anchor-run, generate matched random control intervals from the same range and unit.
controls.multiple_comparisons: Correct for the number of anchors/windows tested.
controls.baseline: Estimate ordinary action timing distribution for each provider/device before testing anchor enrichment.

interpretation.anchor_enrichment: A statistically reproducible excess of actions near preregistered anchors relative to matched controls.
interpretation.cross_device_coherence: Independent devices/providers show comparable enrichment under the same preregistered protocol.
interpretation.not_sufficient_for_transfer: Temporal coincidence alone does not establish communication, shared memory or causal transfer between systems.
